capabilities: Scan a folder for Bible references, including abbreviations, ranges, lists and whole chapters
Generate an index page with plain Markdown links to each citing page
Schedule automatic index rebuilds after the folder goes idle
Produce a coverage report of cited and uncited Bible chapters
disambiguation: Not a Bible reader or reference lookup tool; it only indexes references that appear in your own notes.
extras: The generated index page is fully overwritten on rebuild, so any manual edits to it are lost. Only English book names in the 66-book Protestant canon are recognized.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog every Bible reference across a book's pages or to publish that index with a static site generator.

relations.evidence: so mdBook (or any static site generator) can publish it as-is

summary: Scripture reference indexer that scans a book folder and builds a single Markdown index page of every Bible reference, linking back to the citing pages.
